name: Hana
source:
"Miladies, it's almost time for your afternoon tea..."

A maid working at the mansion. Despite always showing a sour face, Hana is a very competent maid, and could be counted as the mansion's best maid. She also often claims to be able to do anything. For some reason, she is always blaming [url=/c34812]Taro[/url] for everything, and is almost overprotective of [url=/c34817]Yumiko[/url]. As Hana keeps her real identity a secret, the others don't know anything about her aside from the fact that she's very proficient at her job.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=629165]Getchu[/url]]
